method: Humerus-proxy atlas fit at first pose; each vertex projects onto first model path origin-to-insertion axis. Humerus rigid motion plus 0.25*(1-fraction)^2 of the model path displacement relative to rigid motion; all 101 synthetic poses per exercise audited.
limitations: Source mesh does not have validated individual attachment landmarks
The TSM paths and bench/press poses are model-generated, not measured workouts
Nearest path-surface distance does not validate skinning, tissue strain, activation or force
